title: Viking Age expansion
summary: On 8 June 793 Viking raiders struck Lindisfarne, and for about the next 300 years Scandinavians raided, traded and settled across Europe and the North Atlantic. They settled Iceland and Greenland, colonized Normandy, established the Danelaw in Britain and traded as far as the Byzantine Empire. They were the first Europeans to visit North America, at sites such as L'Anse aux Meadows. Most scholars end the Viking Age in 1066, with Harald Hardrada's death at Stamford Bridge.

uncertainty.note: Traditionally begins with the raid on Lindisfarne on 8 June 793 CE and closes with the death of Harald Hardrada at Stamford Bridge in 1066 CE, though sporadic raiding and settlement consolidation continued to c. 1100 CE.
